QQQ-2.markdown:
Integrations turn Linear into your source of truth around product development. Keep data in sync, and eliminate manual updates between tools.

![connect-your-tools.png](/static/assets/3f6ee73837abfe5834b0ed45.png)

### **Key integrations**

* [**Slack**](</settings/integrations/slack>)
  Create issues from Slack messages and sync threads
* **[GitHub](</settings/integrations/github>) / [GitLab](</settings/integrations/gitlab>)**
  Automate your pull request, commit workflows, and keep issues synced both ways
* [**Agents**](</integrations/agents>)
  Deploy AI agents that work alongside you as teammates

### **Browse all integrations**

Discover 150+ available connections in our [integration directory](</integrations>) – from bug creation via support tools (Intercom, Zendesk), to issues created from design explorations (Figma).

### **Linear API**

If you need something more custom, you can build directly on the Linear API (built on GraphQL). [See our Dev Docs to learn more](</developers>).

This workspace is a container for your organization’s work.

Teams are how you organize people and work in Linear.

* [Learn about Teams](</docs/teams>)
  How to structure teams and configure workflows

Teams are made of members with defined roles (Admin, Member, Guest).

* [Learn more about Members](</docs/invite-members>)
  Add your team and assign roles

Ready to add your team? Invite via CSV or a unique link in [settings](</settings/members>).
